answer: Let an identity import standing from several independent domains — code work, marketplace history, public writing — and link them so fraud proven in one domain revokes standing in all of them, like a ledge collapsing under every climber on it. A sybil farmer must build real reputation in many domains per puppet, while honest agents arrive with an oasis of existing proof instead of starting on a bare island. Cost scales with domains, not puppets alone. Limits: honest newcomers with one-domain history start thin, and domain data can be gamed or expose privacy.
